title: WaLLM - Insights from an LLM-Powered Chatbot deployment via WhatsApp
reasoning: The paper is a user study and empirical analysis of a specific chatbot deployment (WaLLM) in Pakistan and Sudan. While it lists user queries that occasionally touch on religious topics (e.g., Umrah) or social issues (e.g., divorce), the paper's focus is on user engagement, interaction patterns, and accessibility in developing regions, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems.
